title: A RUNNING PILLAGER FIRED ON FIGHTS BACK
why: His note of 2026-10-12: a running pillager bot should turn hostile when fired on. A pillager under 30 percent health runs for a ring, and since v2.93 a round into him only made him more alert, so he kept running while you shot him. Fired on by you or your teammate, he now turns hostile, comes for the shooter and fires back, and he stays in the fight instead of bolting again on the next hit. Your own hires and pillagers who joined you are unchanged.
now: A fleeing pillager you shoot now turns and fights back instead of running.
